title: The average that is not
description:
This program should print the average of 4, 5 and 6, which is `5`. It prints `11`.

It compiles without complaint, so this is a **logic error**: the code says something different from what the author meant. Find it and fix it.
hints: Work it out by hand the way the computer does. Which happens first in `a + b + c / 3`: the additions or the division?
Division happens before addition, so only `c` is divided. Add brackets: `(a + b + c) / 3`.
